desc: Ideation: reduce to per-root-to-node-path longest unique-value suffix; track window start via last-seen depths; O(n) DFS.

Implement full solution: adjacency list + iterative DFS (enter/exit events) from node 0, maintaining path stack, last-seen map, startDepth with save/restore on backtrack, and best-answer updates with correct tie-breaking.
Fix `saved_stack` scoping: make it a local variable inside `longestSpecialPath` (currently a module-level global, risking stale state across multiple calls and unclear initialization).
Verify against Example 1 (expect [6,2]) and Example 2 (expect [0,1]), plus edge cases: chain with all-equal values, star tree, deep chain (recursion-limit safety).
